title: AI Harness Catalog: harness capabilities for AI applications, by architecture archetype
description: An open catalog of what must exist around a model call for an AI application to be production grade: 98 harness capabilities across 16 layers and 10 architecture archetypes, each discharging obligations from the AI Assurance Catalog. Part of Clean AI Engineering.
